info.title: Sim API v2 — Workspace Resources
info.description: Version 2 of the Sim REST API for workspace metadata, members, MCP servers, skills, custom tools, sandboxes, credentials, write-only secrets, and the block, tool, and connector-type catalogs.

get.description:
Discover up to 1,000 tools within 5 MB, connect to the server, and update connection metadata. Results are unpaginated. Invalid OAuth returns `409` with `MCP_SERVER_REAUTHORIZATION_REQUIRED`; reauthorize through the browser. Unavailable servers return `503`. `HEAD` checks access with the same authorization as `GET` but skips side effects, returning an empty `200` without payload headers on success. Workspace API keys return `403`; use a personal API key or scoped OAuth token.

OAuth scope: `api:write`.

placeholder.description: Placeholder shown in the key field.

optional.description: Whether the key may be left blank, for a source reachable without authentication.

auth.description: How the connector authenticates against its source.

configFields.description: Fields that make up the connector’s `sourceConfig`.

supportsIncrementalSync.description: Whether syncs after the first fetch only what changed.

id.description: Semantic tag identifier the connector populates.

fieldType.description: Value type, which decides the tag slot pool it draws from.

tagDefinitions.description: Tags this connector writes onto the documents it syncs.

V2ConnectorType.title: Connector type
V2ConnectorType.description: A knowledge-base connector type and the configuration it accepts.

type.description: Control the field renders as. A `selector` fetches its options from the connected account.

required.description: Whether a value must be supplied.

id.description: Value stored when this option is selected.

selectorKey.description: Names the picker a `selector` field renders. Its options are fetched per workspace.

mimeType.description: MIME type filter applied to the picker.

dependsOn.description: Sibling fields this field is cleared by when they change.

all.description: Every listed field must hold a value.

any.description: At least one listed field must hold a value.

mode.description: Which half of a canonical pair this field is: `basic` is the picker, `advanced` the manual entry.

canonicalParamId.description: Shared `sourceConfig` key for a picker/manual-entry pair. Send exactly one of the pair, keyed by this value rather than by the field’s own `id`.

multi.description: When true the stored `sourceConfig` value is a `string[]`, not a `string`: a `selector` renders a multi-select picker and a `short-input` accepts a comma-separated list.
